issues: 30px 设计坐标的一句小字漂在浅灰底中间，画面几乎是空的
滚轮只是平面词条平移 + 压扁，没有机械转筒的体积感
三次换词等距等长，节奏平均，结论词没有比例子更重
结尾整组淡出到空白，尾帧什么都没有
changes: look 换成 lime（石墨 · 荧光黄绿）：176px / 850 字重一句大字横贯画面，横贯全幅的选取带钉住中心行，左上眉题、右上 mono 计数 01→04
滚轮做成真 3D 转筒：词贴在半径 ≈343px 的圆柱面上（相邻 32°），按 (i-p)·θ 算 y/z/rotateX 前缩，邻行再按距离叠纵向高斯模糊与转速运动模糊
保留 0.7·outQuint + 0.3·outBack 换词曲线和 d<0.42 才染色的规则；落定瞬间加一次泛光衰减，结论词留余温
节奏改成越换越密：开场滚入首词，hold 16f→10f→10f，结论词「everyone.」那段 24f 最长最重
收尾不再淡出：邻行滚走、选取带收起，只留「Built for everyone.」+ 44px 副标题的海报；句干与转筒共用行盒，基线严格对齐；时长 150→165f
issuesEn: A 30px design-space line floated in the middle of a light-grey frame that was almost empty
The reel was a flat strip of words sliding and squashing, with no sense of a mechanical drum
The three changes were evenly spaced and equal length, so the conclusion carried no more weight than the examples
The ending faded everything out to an empty last frame
changesEn: Lime look (graphite, neon yellow-green): one 176px / 850-weight sentence across the frame, a full-width selection band locking the centre row, a kicker top-left and a mono 01→04 counter top-right
A true 3D drum: words sit on a cylinder of radius ≈343px (32° apart) with y/z/rotateX from (i-p)·θ for foreshortening, plus distance-based vertical Gaussian blur and speed-based motion blur
The 0.7·outQuint + 0.3·outBack step curve and the tint-only-below-d 0.42 rule are kept; each landing gets one decaying glow, and the final word keeps a little warmth
The rhythm tightens: the first word rolls in, holds go 16f→10f→10f, and the conclusion 'everyone.' gets the longest, heaviest 24f step
No fade-out: neighbours roll away and the band retracts, leaving a 'Built for everyone.' poster with a 44px subline; stem and reel share one line box so baselines match exactly; 150→165f
